title: feat(builtin-deps): Add unstable `builtin-dependencies` feature
body:
### What does this PR try to resolve?

As part of https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/16960, this PR adds a new unstable feature which will be used to gate the `builtin = true` syntax on builtin dependencies.

This PR is part of a chain:
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17497
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17498
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17499
- https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17500

### How to test and review this PR?

This PR adds a unit test to demonstrate that the allowed feature gate works. It also adds documentation for the feature gate. `cargo test` passes on all commits.

r? @Muscraft
